version: 0.4.1
tagline: A small accuracy fix: the HP check now reads correctly in the open world.

## Fixed
- Open-world monsters lose 4.5x the damage shown, so the HP check said ⚠ 23% on kills where every hit was seen. It now allows for that and shows ✓ (your DPS was always right and is unchanged)
